archetypes.name: The Collector
archetypes.description: Deeply knowledgeable wine enthusiast seeking rare and allocated bottles. Has an extensive personal cellar and attends wine auctions.
conversation_hints: mentions recent auction purchases
asks about your allocation list
name-drops specific vineyards and vintages
compares vintages knowledgeably
wants to see the reserve list
asks about provenance and storage conditions

archetypes.name: The Business Dinner
archetypes.description: Hosting clients or colleagues at an important dinner. Wants to appear knowledgeable and generous without overthinking it.
conversation_hints: wants something 'impressive' for the table
asks what you'd recommend for a special occasion
glances at the check discreetly
defers to you as the expert
wants recognizable names their guests will appreciate
asks for Champagne to start

archetypes.name: The Couple
archetypes.description: Celebrating a milestone — anniversary, birthday, engagement. Wants a romantic, memorable wine experience.
conversation_hints: mentions anniversary or birthday
asks for 'something special'
wants to know the story behind the wine
interested in pairing suggestions for the full menu
asks about Champagne or sparkling to celebrate
wants a wine they can remember this night by

archetypes.name: The Wine Snob
archetypes.description: Has extensive but sometimes inaccurate knowledge. Tests the sommelier's expertise aggressively. Rewards competence with respect and big orders.
conversation_hints: corrects your pronunciation (sometimes incorrectly)
asks trick questions about vintages
mentions their own cellar collection
dismisses your first suggestion
asks about specific producers to test you
quotes critic scores

archetypes.name: The Adventurer
archetypes.description: Passionate about discovering unusual wines from lesser-known regions. Values authenticity and story over prestige scores.
conversation_hints: asks about natural or minimal-intervention wines
wants something they've never tried before
interested in indigenous grape varieties
asks about the winemaker's philosophy
excited by orange wines, pet-nat, or amphora-aged wines
wants the most unusual thing on your list

archetypes.name: The Value Seeker
archetypes.description: Appreciates good wine but is genuinely budget-conscious. Not cheap — just wants the best QPR on the list.
conversation_hints: asks about by-the-glass options
looks at prices before descriptions
appreciates when you suggest hidden gems at good prices
asks if any half bottles are available
wants to split a bottle with the table
asks which wines are the best value

archetypes.name: The Newcomer
archetypes.description: First time at a fine dining restaurant or new to wine entirely. Needs patient, jargon-free guidance.
conversation_hints: admits they don't know much about wine
asks 'what's good?' without being more specific
says they usually drink beer or cocktails
worried about choosing the 'wrong' wine
intimidated by the wine list size
asks if you have anything 'not too dry'

archetypes.name: The Critic
archetypes.description: Restaurant or wine critic dining anonymously. Every detail of service, list depth, and wine condition will be evaluated and published.
conversation_hints: takes notes discreetly on their phone
asks unusually detailed questions about the wine program
orders wines from different sections of the list
seems to be evaluating the glassware and service tempo
asks about your wine storage conditions
requests to see the full wine list, not the abbreviated version
